stage: Deterministic error enclosure of an existing population screening; not a new simulation or preregistered discovery
ordinary_capacity_constraint: delta(Sigma)=1; define b by its root in the existing brackets
normal_integration: Product of conditional normal means on fixed dyadic cell boundaries, with convexity lower bound and a smoothness upper remainder covering all tails
projection_validation: Feasible box primal value and first-order concave dual gap, checked directly from the original quadratic for every node
scope: Only a strict population gap for the stated existing three-task model, if the computed enclosure separates. No new estimator, ordinary-correlated-capacity novelty, empirical prevalence or independent proof-review claim.
manuscript_integration: Deferred until the proof, numerical enclosure and practical effect size are assessed
